3.0.2.summaryZh: 新增 PicGo CLI 按需上传，优化大文档阅读、目录公式与本地文档保存。
3.0.2.summaryEn: Add on-demand PicGo CLI uploads and improve large documents, outline equations and local saving.

3.1.0.summaryZh: 支持图表放大、文档包编辑和顶部更新提示，优化即时渲染的大表格编辑，修复表格下方输入错位、输入法切换模式和公式粘贴。
3.1.0.summaryEn: Enlarge charts, edit document bundles, and see update banners; enjoy faster live tables, reliable typing below tables, IME mode switches, and formula pasting.

3.2.0.summaryZh: 新增本地 MP4／WebM 和 HTTPS 视频点播，优化即时渲染中的大表格、图片预览和公式定位。
3.2.0.summaryEn: Play local MP4/WebM and HTTPS video in live editing, and enjoy smoother large tables, image previews, and formula navigation.
